items.name: component-contract
items.title: Component Contract
items.description: The serialized parametric-component contract (Phase 32.1): definition schema, parameter descriptors, ports, preview metadata, canonical serialization, and strict-on-known-fields parse with structured component-contract/* refusals.

items.name: component-kernel
items.title: Component Kernel
items.description: The kernel-neutral execution surface components build through: the async ComponentKernel mirror of GeometryKernel plus directComponentKernel for in-process kernels.

items.name: cad-component
items.title: CAD Component
items.description: The runtime component model: what a CadComponent is (definition + build + ports), the structured build result shapes, and defineComponent validation.

items.name: context-kernel
items.title: Context Kernel
items.description: The ComponentKernel adapter that runs every component call over a ComputationContext — the stale-result-coordinated worker-protocol client browser sessions dispatch through.

items.name: nema17-mount
items.title: NEMA 17 Stepper Mount
items.description: Faceplate mount for a NEMA 17 frame stepper (NEMA ICS 16: 42.3 mm faceplate, 31 mm M3 grid, ISO 273 clearance): square plate, register bore, optional collar — seven parameters, five ports, one body.

items.name: arduino-mount
items.title: Arduino UNO R3 Mount
items.description: Mounting base for an Arduino UNO R3 (official drawing: 68.58 x 53.34 mm, four standoff bosses incl. the 50.80 mm shield pair): five parameters, four ports, one body.

items.name: enclosure
items.title: Electronics Enclosure
items.description: Two-body electronics enclosure (shell + seated lid) with rounded rectangular profile, screw bosses, and lid pilots — twelve parameters, five ports, two bodies.

items.name: nema17-assembly-example
items.title: NEMA 17 Assembly Study (example)
items.description: A complete headless composition example: builds the NEMA 17 mount, the Arduino UNO mount, and the enclosure through one kernel, lays the bodies out along x from their own measured bounds, and reports per-body volumes plus the mount's kernel-free ports.

items.name: parametric-cad-viewer
items.title: Parametric CAD Viewer
items.description: One installable block that draws a part beside its variables: the CAD viewport rendering pre-tessellated bodies under a deterministic home camera, and the Formedible parameter panel editing the native document's variables through a real parameter.set-interpreting store. Honest boundary: it renders and edits but does not evaluate geometry — re-derivation after an edit rides the consumer-supplied rebuild callback (or the onDocumentChange escape hatch), never a faked re-drive.
